title: Retry XZ frame and cache roots beyond both JDK constructors
description: Both supported XZ versions reproduced the DataInputStream and access-ordered LinkedHashMap constructor stops. Execute the selected DataInputStream image and the actual LinkedHashMap constructor on the fieldless application cache subclass, preserving virtual override resolution. Retry all four registered frames, ordinary callers, cache identities, and first/repeated erroneous class profiles on both releases. Keep the earlier receipts and their source.
expected: The public digests and the eight registered frame outputs remain qualified. Each fixed-profile native attempt either decides its original statement or records the next reached operation. Invalid cache first-use and repeated-use witnesses retain their independent JVM check.
